decision_principle: Hosting ownership and RIVET presentation are separate decisions. The approved RIVET brand remains frozen in every lane.

options.label: Evercraft-owned Fabric / Compute
options.frontend: Approved RIVET surface reproduced without brand changes
options.backend: Evercraft Compute + Systemia + approved AliEV integrations
options.recurring_external_hosting_cost: Not responsibly priced yet. Existing owned capacity may reduce marginal provider spend, but operations, redundancy, uptime and support must be measured before quoting a monthly number.
strengths: health-gated promotion and rollback contracts already proven in repository
risks: RIVET-specific public route is intentionally withdrawn pending approval
must prove external uptime, backups and disaster recovery before cutover
options.recommendation_condition: Choose only if partners want Evercraft to operate production and accept a measured pre-cutover reliability gate.

options.label: Partner-owned DigitalOcean App Platform
options.frontend: Static or containerized approved RIVET surface
options.backend: Can remain partner-hosted or call an explicitly approved Evercraft/AliEV backend
options.recurring_external_hosting_cost: Static sites can start at $0. Dynamic containers start at $5/mo for 512 MiB, $10/mo for 1 GiB fixed, $12/mo for 1 GiB scalable, and $25/mo for 2 GiB. Development database starts at $7/mo. Extra outbound transfer is $0.02/GiB.
risks: application and database charges rise with scale
backend architecture must be chosen separately

options.label: Partner-owned AWS Lightsail
options.frontend: Approved RIVET surface on a predictable VM/container architecture
options.backend: Partner-hosted or explicitly approved Evercraft/AliEV integration
options.recurring_external_hosting_cost: Linux virtual server bundles currently start at $5/mo for 0.5 GB RAM and 1 TB transfer, $7/mo for 1 GB RAM and 2 TB transfer, and $12/mo for 2 GB RAM and 3 TB transfer.
strengths: high portability from a standard server stack
risks: patching/deployment architecture must be owned deliberately

options.label: Partner-owned Vercel Pro
options.frontend: Strong fit for a web-first/static or modern framework RIVET surface
options.backend: May require separate services for persistent data or deeper workloads
options.recurring_external_hosting_cost: Pro is currently $20/mo with $20 of included usage credit. Additional developer seats are listed at $20/mo. Usage and add-ons can increase the bill.
risks: backend/data architecture may still live elsewhere
framework/platform coupling can increase over time

options.label: Hybrid: partner-owned RIVET frontend + Evercraft intelligence backend
options.account_control: Partners control domain/frontend account; Evercraft controls only explicitly approved backend services
options.frontend: Partner-funded managed host with frozen approved RIVET presentation
options.backend: AliEV/Systemia/Evercraft services behind explicit versioned contracts
options.recurring_external_hosting_cost: Frontend provider cost plus any separately agreed Evercraft operating cost. No combined number should be quoted until the backend authority and support model are agreed.
strengths: Evercraft can improve intelligence without repainting RIVET
easy to replace either side independently
risks: network dependency between frontend and backend
options.recommendation_condition: Strong default when partners want direct control of the RIVET brand/domain but still want Evercraft intelligence underneath.

hard_gates: explicit partner approval of hosting lane
exact core brand asset fidelity audit pass
pixel-level desktop and mobile visual review
